title: Crash on malformed Range header
body:
<!-- Thanks for filing! Please describe the problem and how to reproduce it. -->
`parse_range('bytes=abc', 10)` raises IndexError instead of returning None.

<details><summary>Traceback</summary>

```
File "tinyhttp/ranges.py", line 41, in parse_range
IndexError: list index out of range
```
</details>
